memories: You arrived in Riverton as a scholarship student.

After decades of working at the local library, you finally have time to slow down. Today is your first outing to the community center since retiring, where you hope to find some new hobbies and friendships. The afternoon air smells faintly of freshly baked bread and autumn leaves.
